newsitem.title: USA: Tech stock sell-off pushes Nasdaq lower.
newsitem.headline: Tech stock sell-off pushes Nasdaq lower.

text.p: Nasdaq shares crumbled after 3Com Corp's dismal third quarter forecast sparked a massive sell-off in technology shares, traders said.

The Nasdaq Composite Index lost 22.37 points or 1.64 percent to close unofficially at 1335.34. Weakness in technology shares spread to other sectors, forcing the Dow industrials down 49 points or 0.72 percent to 6806, an unofficial close. The long-bond lost 1/32 to 6.70 percent.
"There was weakness is anything tech-related. It was a tough day to be a tech," said one trader. "It's a skittish market and bad news feeds on itself."
Traders said nervousness in the technology sector will likely continue into Tuesday's session.
3Com plunged 13-1/2 to 37-1/2 in heavy trading after it warned its fiscal third quarter earnings would fall short of Wall Street expectations and analysts downgraded the stock.
Other networking stocks were slammed by 3Com's woes. Cisco Systems Inc plunged 5-1/8 to 58 and Ascend Communications Inc dropped 4-10/16 to 62-10/16.
Intel Corp lost 4-3/4 to 151-5/8. Microsoft Corp fell 2-5/8 to 97-3/4. Overall, Nasdaq losers beat gainers 2555 to 1851 on volume of about 643 million shares.
